'''Star Tours Flight 712''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had arrived on time at Gate 2D at 0650 hours and was boarding passengers for its next departure at 0745.
